confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded from a few crowdsourced and aggregated sources (Expat Arrivals, Expatistan, LifeIndexed, GigaFact citing Numbeo) and are approximate. Beer and cocktail anchors are the least certain, since sources conflicted and happy-hour prices were lower than non-happy-hour prices. Wine uses the local beer-to-wine relationship as a fallback, and the cocktail anchor is a judgement estimate. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Denver lodging; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Estimates are based on Denver's own published price aggregates for food and drink, plus general knowledge of US mid-to-large city lodging for accommodation.
